title: tilia pubescens
intro: Tilia pubescens, commonly known as small-leaved lime, is a deciduous tree or shrub species that belongs to the Tilia genus. It is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate anxiety, and soothe respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Tilia pubescens include sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, making it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies. The bioactive constituents of Tilia pubescens include flavonoids, terpenoids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
